# Productivity System

My personal productivity framework based on GTD.

## Capture

Collect everything that has your attention.

- Inbox zero for email
- Quick capture for ideas
- Voice memos for on-the-go

## Clarify

Process inbox items to actionable tasks.

- Is it actionable?
- What's the next action?
- Can it be done in 2 minutes?

## Organize

Put things where they belong.

### Projects

Outcomes requiring multiple actions.

- [ ] Launch MEMORA v0.1
- [ ] Write technical documentation
- [ ] Set up CI/CD pipeline

### Areas

Ongoing responsibilities.

- Health & Fitness
- Learning & Growth
- Finance
- Relationships

## Reflect

Regular reviews to stay on track.

### Weekly Review

Every Sunday, 30 minutes.

1. Clear inboxes
2. Review projects
3. Plan next week
4. Update areas

### Monthly Review

First of each month, 60 minutes.

1. Review goals
2. Adjust areas
3. Plan major projects

## Engage

Do the work with intention.

### Time Blocking

Dedicated blocks for deep work.

- Morning: Creative work (9-11am)
- Afternoon: Meetings & admin (1-4pm)
- Evening: Learning (7-8pm)

### Pomodoro

25 min focus, 5 min break.
